com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.taskmapping

Interface ITaskMapping


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface ITaskMapping
    A task mapping (ITaskMapping) represents an IEvent (also called trigger) that is mapped to a task in the context of a component prototype or a module configuration. It corresponds to the task mapping container in the RTE configuration.

      • getActivationOffset

        @PublishedMethod
java.math.BigDecimal getActivationOffset()
        Retrieves the activation offset (in seconds) of the task mapping.

        The activation offset in seconds or null if no activation offset is set.

        @PublishedMethod
IEvent getEvent()

      • getMappedTask

        @PublishedMethod
com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIContainer getMappedTask()
        Retrieves the task to which the event (trigger) is mapped.

      • getOwnerDescription

        @PublishedMethod
java.lang.String getOwnerDescription()
        Retrieves the name of the executable entity (function) owner. May be a SwComponentPrototype or a ModuleConfiguration.
        Returns:
        Either the name of the component or the module configuration. Returns an empty String if cannot determine the owner.

      • getPositionInTask

        @PublishedMethod
int getPositionInTask()
        Retrieves the position of this ITaskMapping.
        Returns:
        The current position in task or -1 when not assigned

      • setActivationOffset

        @PublishedMethod
void setActivationOffset(java.math.BigDecimal offsetInSeconds)
        Sets the activation offset parameter at the task mapping container to the given offsetInSeconds value.
